tweaks.name: Disable Telemetry
tweaks.description: Disables Microsoft telemetry, advertising ID, targeted ads and speech data collection.

tweaks.name: Disable Activity History
tweaks.description: Erases recent docs, clipboard and run history tracking.

tweaks.name: Disable Location Tracking
tweaks.description: Denies location access for apps and disables sensor permission.

tweaks.name: Disable Delivery Optimization
tweaks.description: Stops Windows using your bandwidth to upload updates to other PCs.

tweaks.name: Disable Consumer Features
tweaks.description: Stops promoted app installs and Store content suggestions.

tweaks.name: Disable WPBT
tweaks.description: Prevents your PC vendor from running programs at boot (anti-theft, forced software).

tweaks.name: Set Time to UTC
tweaks.description: Fixes clock drift when dual booting with Linux.

tweaks.name: Show File Extensions
tweaks.description: Shows .exe, .png etc. in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Show Hidden Files
tweaks.description: Reveals hidden files in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Dark Theme
tweaks.description: Enables dark mode for the system and apps.

tweaks.name: Disable Lock Screen
tweaks.description: Skips the lock screen and goes straight to sign-in.

tweaks.name: Hide Start Menu Recommendations
tweaks.description: Removes the recommended section from the Start menu.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing in Start Search
tweaks.description: Removes Bing web results from Start menu search.

tweaks.name: End Task with Right Click
tweaks.description: Adds an End Task option when right-clicking a program on the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Icons Left
tweaks.description: Aligns taskbar icons to the left like Windows 10.

tweaks.name: Hide Widgets Button
tweaks.description: Removes the widgets button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Classic Right-Click Menu
tweaks.description: Restores the full classic context menu in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Enable Long Paths
tweaks.description: Supports file paths longer than 260 characters.

tweaks.name: Game Mode
tweaks.description: Lets Windows prioritize system resources for games.

tweaks.name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
tweaks.description: Disables FSO for all apps (can help with exclusive fullscreen games).

tweaks.name: Disable Background Apps
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft Store apps from running in the background.

tweaks.name: Disable Mouse Acceleration
tweaks.description: Removes mouse acceleration for consistent aiming.

tweaks.name: Disable Multiplane Overlay
tweaks.description: Can fix stutter caused by overlay composition issues on some GPUs.

tweaks.name: Visual Effects: Best Performance
tweaks.description: Turns off animations and eye candy for snappier UI.

tweaks.name: Disable Hibernation
tweaks.description: Disables hibernation and removes hiberfil.sys (saves disk space).

tweaks.name: Disable Sticky Keys
tweaks.description: Stops the Shift-pressed-5-times Sticky Keys prompt.

tweaks.name: Enable Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling
tweaks.description: Lets the GPU manage its own scheduling, reducing CPU overhead in games. Requires reboot.

tweaks.name: Disable Game DVR Recording
tweaks.description: Disables Game Bar background recording, a known source of micro-stutter in games.

tweaks.name: High Performance Power Plan
tweaks.description: Switches Windows to the High Performance power plan so the CPU never downclocks.

tweaks.name: Disable Memory Integrity (HVCI)
tweaks.description: Disables VBS memory integrity. Can improve FPS and frame pacing on older CPUs. Security tradeoff, requires reboot.

tweaks.name: Disable CPU Mitigations
tweaks.description: Disables Spectre/Meltdown mitigations for a small CPU gain on older CPUs (pre-12th gen). Security tradeoff, requires reboot.

tweaks.name: Edge Debloat
tweaks.description: Disables Edge telemetry, shopping assistant, Rewards, first-run experience and more.

tweaks.name: Disable Storage Sense
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from auto-deleting temp files.

tweaks.name: Disable Reserved Storage
tweaks.description: Frees 7-10 GB held for updates (recommended only on small drives).

tweaks.name: File Explorer Home & Gallery
tweaks.description: Removes Home and Gallery from Explorer and opens This PC by default.

tweaks.name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
tweaks.description: Can improve latency on networks without IPv6.

tweaks.name: Disable Teredo
tweaks.description: Disables Teredo tunneling, which can cause latency in some games.

tweaks.name: Create Restore Point
tweaks.description: Creates a system restore point so you can revert tweaks.

tweaks.name: Disk Cleanup
tweaks.description: Runs Disk Cleanup and removes old Windows updates.

tweaks.name: Remove Temp Files
tweaks.description: Erases TEMP folders for all users.
